text:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-queue latency spike detected in us-west-2. 99p latency >2s, 5xx rate rising. Paging on-call now.
sam: Oncall here — pulling dashboards and logs. Marking P1 until mitigations in. tagging @maria @jordan to join.
maria: Looking at runtime metrics — inflight at ~92% on shard-gpu-3, KV cache miss rate spiking. Any recent deploys?
eli: No deploys in the last hour from infra. Noticed a large burst from tenant 'summit-ai' hitting long-context embeddings + chat.
sam: Customer impact: ~6 tenants with >50% error increase, 3 tenants seeing intermittent 504s. Plan: temporarily throttle heavy clients and reduce max_inflight to 10 in us-west-2.
jordan: What's the intended path to change max_inflight? runtime flag, config service, or live route policy? I can push traffic-plane rules if given the values.
sam: Using runtime config for in-flight cap and a short-lived global rate-limit for hosted. I'll apply both.
sam: ```sh
opsctl set-runtime-config --path=/runtime/limits/max_inflight --value=10 --region=us-west-2
opsctl set-rate-limit --scope=global-hosted --factor=0.5 --reason='live-mitigation-3725'
```
ops-tooling-bot: Runbook action: rate-limit applied (scope=global-hosted, factor=0.5, id=rl-3725).
maria: Also suggest lowering per-account concurrent slots for free/trial tiers to 2 to protect reserved customers.
eli: I'm toggling embeddings low-priority flag for non-paid tiers to reduce token churn (flag: embeddings-lowprio=false).
jordan: Applying max_inflight=10 to us-west-2 now and doing a rolling restart of runtime-proxy nodes (graceful). Monitoring heatmaps.
sam: 5-10m after changes: 99p latency down from ~2.3s to ~700ms. Error rate for affected tenants down ~60%. One large customer still reporting errors — will route them to a small-model fallback.
jordan: Executing tenant-level override for summit-ai: `routectl override --tenant summit-ai --model redwood-small --duration 30m`
eli: Override applied. Summit-ai health check passed on the smaller model; they confirmed reduced errors and acceptable latency.
sam: Handoff: I'm handing off monitoring to @jordan for the next 2 hours. Keep current throttles and max_inflight cap. SRE follow-up: log KV cache sizing for shard-gpu-3 and review cache policies.
jordan: Ack. I'll watch metrics and alerts. Will escalate if error rate climbs above 5% sustained. Please open an incident ticket with the sequence of actions.
ops-tooling-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-3725. Actions recorded: rate-limit rl-3725, max_inflight change to 10, embeddings flag toggle, tenant route override for summit-ai.
sam: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Postmortem requested — include customer-impact table, mitigation timeline, and graphs for 99p latency and inflight by shard.
